verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents a RAG API that integrates with the app to give context-aware responses based on user-uploaded files. Agents also support file handling, and agent files can be managed through the Agent Management API, so documents can be attached as reusable knowledge. Missing for 10: detail on persistent knowledge-base organization (collections, notes), evidence of citation or grounding fidelity, and independent hands-on corroboration of retrieval quality.
